metaDescription: UPCA Sweet syn 1 corn is a yellow open pollinated corn variety. 70 to 75 days to harvest, 5.5 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: UPCA Sweet syn 1 corn is a yellow open pollinated corn variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1970. It takes 70 to 75 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 5.5 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about UPCA Sweet syn 1 corn

blocks.caption: Key facts of UPCA Sweet syn 1

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

UPCA Sweet syn 1 corn takes 70 to 75 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is 29.1 days faster than the average of the 28 yellow open pollinated corn varieties with a day count, 101.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 5.5 t/ha trails the average of its group, 5.88. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant UPCA Sweet syn 1 corn

Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 70 to 75 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 5.5 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
Yes. It is open pollinated, so seed from a clean, isolated field grows true. Still, certified seed gives the best start every few seasons.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of UPCA Sweet syn 1?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
